facts.claim: Holding $HUHCAT pays you in SOL, automatically, several times an hour.
facts.detail: Creator fee routed to holders by pump.fun. Pro-rata by balance. No claiming, no staking.
facts.verify: Watch your own wallet after holding more than $20 worth.

facts.claim: The eligibility floor is holding more than $20 worth.
facts.detail: Below that you are a spectator, above it you are on the payout list.
facts.verify: Hold a small amount, watch which transfers land.

facts.claim: One measured hour: 1.81 SOL to holders across 1,807 payments in 207 batches.
facts.detail: Measured directly from chain on 17 Sep 2026. Distribution volume drifts with trading, the mechanism does not.
facts.verify: Sum any hour yourself from the distribution wallet activity.

facts.claim: Once a token is Holder Rewards it cannot be changed.
facts.detail: pump.fun's own rule, stated verbatim in their launch announcement.

facts.claim: The rate is set by market cap tier, from a peak of 0.950 percent down to a floor of 0.050 percent.
facts.detail: 25 tiers, published in SOL. The rate moves both directions as market cap moves. No one on this team sets it.

facts.claim: The first image inscribed on Solana in a v1 transaction is this cat.
facts.detail: Minutes after v1 activated on 15 Sep 2026, slot 447120000. An exhaustive scan of 729 blocks examined 881,986 transactions, found 12 using v1, and exactly 1 carried an image.
facts.verify: Decode the metadata yourself on the explorer.

facts.claim: The image is stored on chain. No IPFS, no link, no server.
facts.detail: A JPEG of the real Huh Cat, base64 encoded inside the token metadata of the image mint.
facts.verify: The decoder on this page reads it live from a public RPC.

facts.claim: The image mint is sealed. Supply is 1 and all four authorities are revoked.
facts.detail: Mint, freeze, metadata pointer, metadata update: all null. Sealed 17 Sep 2026 between 02:35 and 02:36 UTC in six transactions.
facts.verify: Open the image mint on any explorer.

facts.claim: The 1 of 1 deed sits in a vault nobody controls.
facts.detail: No admin, no pause, no upgrade authority, no close. The deployed program matches its published source byte for byte. Claim: lock 420,690,000 HUHCAT and the deed is yours. Return: hand the deed back and every locked coin comes back to you.
facts.source: chain read and source audit, 17 Sep 2026
facts.verify: The vault program and its source are linked in the proof wall.

facts.claim: 420,690,000 HUHCAT is 43.83 percent of all supply.
facts.detail: Supply reads 959,904,004 as of 17 Sep 2026. The threshold is fixed in program state and cannot be changed by anyone.
facts.verify: Read the vault state account on any explorer.

facts.claim: The deployer launched the coin and left. The wallet now holds zero.
facts.detail: The community took over. Every account, site, and tool since is holder-built.
facts.verify: Check the deployer wallet balance yourself.

facts.claim: The cat is real. Bender, from Melbourne, owned by Nellie Cage.
facts.detail: 3.4 million TikTok followers and 104.5 million hearts, live on 17 Sep 2026. Featured by SBS News. This community does not own or represent the cat. We credit the public content.
facts.source: TikTok and SBS News, checked 17 Sep 2026
facts.verify: Open the cat's TikTok and the SBS story, both linked in the proof wall.
